evidence.description: Sugbo Mercado has a variety of food stalls offering delicious dishes from different cultures and cuisines. You can find stalls selling street food, grilled seafood, ramen, burgers, empanadas, and desserts. Some stalls also serve fresh fruit juices, smoothies, and fruit kebabs. The open-air setting creates a lively atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for enjoying meals and socializing with family, friends, and tourists.
